```{r setup, include=FALSE, dev='CairoPNG'}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning=FALSE, dev="CairoPNG")
# knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = params$dat.dir)

options(stringsAsFactors = F)
options(scipen = 99)
library(Cairo)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(patchwork)
library(kableExtra)

```

```{r }
## read precomputed data
dat <- readRDS('data.rds')
ss <- dat$ss
meta <- dat$meta
figs <- readRDS('figs.rds')

dp.rds <- 'dp.rds'
if (file.exists(dp.rds)){
  dp.list <- readRDS(dp.rds)
  
  dp_sum <- bind_rows(lapply(dp.list, function(dp){
    bind_rows(lapply(dp, function(x){if(!is.null(x)){x$summary}}))
  })) %>% 
    dplyr::relocate(target, output.folder, control.group, test.group, features.tested:FC.cutoff, control.samples:test.samples)
}


## initiate variables
targets <- sort(setdiff(unique(meta$target), c('IgG', 'Input'))) # targets to make QC plots
ntargets <- length(targets)
ngroups <- length(unique(meta$sample_group))

fig.read.width <- 12
fig.read.height <- max(ngroups*1.2 +2, 8)

fig.peak.width <- 12
fig.peak.height <- max(ngroups*1.2 +2, 8)

fig.rep.width <- 12
fig.rep.height <- max(ngroups +2, 8)

fig.conp.height <- ntargets*2+1
fig.conp.height2 <- ntargets+1

fig.conp.width <- ceiling(sqrt(ntargets))*8

```

```{r make_tabs, include=FALSE}
# Function to create multiple tabs
make_tabs <- function(title, contents){
  cat(title, "\n\n")
  for (cnt in contents){print(cnt); cat("\n")}
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

## Summary

This document describes the data analysis of Cut & Run or Cut & Tag experiments.

## Sample sheet

```{r sample_sheet}

ss %>% 
  select(c(id, sample_group, target, sample_replicate, control)) %>%
  arrange(sample_group, target, sample_replicate) %>% 
  unique.data.frame() %>% 
  DT::datatable(
  class = 'cell-border stripe', 
  rownames = T,  
  filter = 'top', 
  editable = F, 
  extensions = 'Buttons', 
  options = list(
    pageLength = 6, 
    dom = 'Bfrtip',
    buttons = c('csv')
  ))

```
